decisions.reason: The offshore vessel management service builds directly on the firm's existing ship management expertise, enabling strong absorptive capacity and effective learning from early results.
The crew and corporate travel management service is peripheral to the firm's core maritime operations, and the firm has limited related knowledge to interpret and improve it.
The online vessel information portal leverages the firm's vessel data and maritime knowledge, though it requires complementary digital capabilities that the firm can develop.
The mobile vessel performance app directly builds on the firm's technical vessel performance monitoring knowledge, making it easy to assimilate and apply improvements.
